scheme_name: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Castes
other_conditions: Institution must be a registered private institution or NGO
Institution must have at least three years experience running coaching for competitive examinations
Institution must not have been declared bankrupt or blacklisted by any government body
Institution must have capacity to manage building/space for coaching classes at Ranchi and Dumka
Candidates must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) and be residents of Jharkhand
Candidates must have the eligible qualifications for the respective competitive exams
Candidates can avail coaching only once for a particular competitive exam and up to two coaching courses in total
Each class may have up to 40 students, with a preference for 30% women SC candidates and 5% disabled SC candidates, and no more than 10% of students from any single district
benefits_summary: Eligible SC candidates receive a monthly stipend of ₹1,000 and boarding/lodging assistance of ₹2,000 per month, along with course fee coverage up to ₹22,000 per candidate.
documents_required: SC certificate in prescribed proforma issued by the competent authority
Undertaking from each admitted candidate confirming no prior receipt of coaching under any government scheme
Photograph and full address of each candidate in the prescribed format
Completed application forms and annexures (printout and soft copy) submitted to the department
